Work on a local branch where the sine argument $\theta$ satisfies $-\pi/2<\theta<\pi/2$. Express the solution as $y=\sin(\boxed{\text{expression}}+C)$.

Expression: {{field-1}}"] [:db/add "a5b2a220-0459-5dce-b547-6284c446511b" :question/worked-solution "First, we separate the variables:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =2(x - 3)\sqrt{1-{y}^{2}} \\ \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{y}^{2}}}\,\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =2(x - 3)\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we integrate both sides with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1-{y}^{2}}}\,\text{d}y & =\int 2(x - 3)\,\text{d}x \\ \operatorname{arcsin}⁡y & ={(x - 3)}^{2}+C\end{aligned}
$$

This is a perfectly valid general solution. However, if we want to write $y=y(x)$ explicitly, then we can solve for $y.$ This gives

$$
y=\operatorname{sin}⁡({(x - 3)}^{2}+C)
$$

where $C$ is an arbitrary constant.

This nonconstant branch applies where $-\pi/2<(x - 3)^2+C<\pi/2$, so $\cos((x - 3)^2+C)>0$. The constant endpoint solutions $y=\pm1$ also solve the ODE."] [:db/add "a5b2a220-0459-5dce-b547-6284c446511b" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "a5b2a220-0459-5dce-b547-6284c446511b" :question/answer-fields "b2736e4d-28a3-5b77-ae75-c0817ba05432"] [:db/ensure "a5b2a220-0459-5dce-b547-6284c446511b" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186100894 :knowledge-point/questions "a5b2a220-0459-5dce-b547-6284c446511b"] [:db/add "3d059536-0109-5359-8442-84b64e83fc4b" :answer/id #uuid "3d059536-0109-5359-8442-84b64e83fc4b"] [:db/add "3d059536-0109-5359-8442-84b64e83fc4b" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "3d059536-0109-5359-8442-84b64e83fc4b" :answer/value "-\frac{5}{(x - 3)}+4{(x - 3)}^{2}+7"] [:db/ensure "3d059536-0109-5359-8442-84b64e83fc4b" :answer/validate] [:db/add "c26ba58a-d6c3-5eca-8d6a-deb9c0b2c874" :answer-field/id #uuid "c26ba58a-d6c3-5eca-8d6a-deb9c0b2c874"] [:db/add "c26ba58a-d6c3-5eca-8d6a-deb9c0b2c874" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "c26ba58a-d6c3-5eca-8d6a-deb9c0b2c874" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "c26ba58a-d6c3-5eca-8d6a-deb9c0b2c874" :answer-field/choices "3d059536-0109-5359-8442-84b64e83fc4b"] [:db/add "c26ba58a-d6c3-5eca-8d6a-deb9c0b2c874" :answer-field/correct "3d059536-0109-5359-8442-84b64e83fc4b"] [:db/ensure "c26ba58a-d6c3-5eca-8d6a-deb9c0b2c874" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "3a0761a3-71cc-54d6-bed4-7a048e3a0e98" :question/id #uuid "3a0761a3-71cc-54d6-bed4-7a048e3a0e98"] [:db/add "3a0761a3-71cc-54d6-bed4-7a048e3a0e98" :question/problem "Find the particular solution to the differential equation ${(x - 3)}^{2}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}-8{(x - 3)}^{3}=5$ that satisfies $y(4)=6.$

$y(x)=$
{{field-1}}"] [:db/add "3a0761a3-71cc-54d6-bed4-7a048e3a0e98" :question/worked-solution "We first find the general solution and then apply the given initial condition to find a particular solution.

Separating variables and integrating both sides with respect to $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{(x - 3)}^{2}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}-8{(x - 3)}^{3} & =5 \\ {(x - 3)}^{2}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =5+8{(x - 3)}^{3} \\ \text{d}y & =(5{(x - 3)}^{-2}+8(x - 3))\,\text{d}x \\ \int \text{d}y & =\int (5{(x - 3)}^{-2}+8(x - 3))\,\text{d}x \\ y & =-5{(x - 3)}^{-1}+4{(x - 3)}^{2}+C.\end{aligned}
$$

We now apply the initial condition $y(4)=6$ to find $C:$

$$
\begin{aligned}y(4) & =6 \\ -5(1)^{-1}+4(1)^{2}+C & =6 \\ C-1 & =6 \\ C & =7\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, the particular solution is

$$
\begin{aligned}y(x) & =-5{(x - 3)}^{-1}+4{(x - 3)}^{2}+7 \\  & =-\frac{5}{(x - 3)}+4{(x - 3)}^{2}+7.\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "3a0761a3-71cc-54d6-bed4-7a048e3a0e98" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "3a0761a3-71cc-54d6-bed4-7a048e3a0e98" :question/answer-fields "c26ba58a-d6c3-5eca-8d6a-deb9c0b2c874"] [:db/ensure "3a0761a3-71cc-54d6-bed4-7a048e3a0e98" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186100894 :knowledge-point/questions "3a0761a3-71cc-54d6-bed4-7a048e3a0e98"] [:db/add "6ae6cdd8-7ece-5bb6-a811-74370a2ba5c5" :answer/id #uuid "6ae6cdd8-7ece-5bb6-a811-74370a2ba5c5"] [:db/add "6ae6cdd8-7ece-5bb6-a811-74370a2ba5c5" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "6ae6cdd8-7ece-5bb6-a811-74370a2ba5c5" :answer/value "\operatorname{ln}(\frac{5}{4}-{e}^{-(x - 1)})"] [:db/ensure "6ae6cdd8-7ece-5bb6-a811-74370a2ba5c5" :answer/validate] [:db/add "0cdf3e68-d4de-5ad4-9574-fd9a9450108d" :answer-field/id #uuid "0cdf3e68-d4de-5ad4-9574-fd9a9450108d"] [:db/add "0cdf3e68-d4de-5ad4-9574-fd9a9450108d" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "0cdf3e68-d4de-5ad4-9574-fd9a9450108d" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "0cdf3e68-d4de-5ad4-9574-fd9a9450108d" :answer-field/choices "6ae6cdd8-7ece-5bb6-a811-74370a2ba5c5"] [:db/add "0cdf3e68-d4de-5ad4-9574-fd9a9450108d" :answer-field/correct "6ae6cdd8-7ece-5bb6-a811-74370a2ba5c5"] [:db/ensure "0cdf3e68-d4de-5ad4-9574-fd9a9450108d" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "8cebb048-16ac-5152-999b-c80ad00cf72f" :question/id #uuid "8cebb048-16ac-5152-999b-c80ad00cf72f"] [:db/add "8cebb048-16ac-5152-999b-c80ad00cf72f" :question/problem "Find the specific solution to the differential equation $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}={e}^{-(x - 1)-y}$ given that $\,y(1)=-\operatorname{ln}⁡4.$

$y(x)=$
{{field-1}}"] [:db/add "8cebb048-16ac-5152-999b-c80ad00cf72f" :question/worked-solution "We first find the general solution and then apply the given initial condition to find a particular solution.

Separating variables and integrating both sides with respect to $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & ={e}^{-(x - 1)-y} \\ \frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & ={e}^{-(x - 1)}{e}^{-y} \\ {e}^{y}\,\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & ={e}^{-(x - 1)} \\ \int {e}^{y}\,\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}\,\text{d}x & =\int {e}^{-(x - 1)}\,\text{d}x \\ \int {e}^{y}\,\text{d}y & =\int {e}^{-(x - 1)}\,\text{d}x \\ {e}^{y} & =-{e}^{-(x - 1)}+C\end{aligned}
$$

Applying the natural logarithm to both sides, we find the general solution:

$$
\begin{aligned}\operatorname{ln}⁡({e}^{y}) & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(-{e}^{-(x - 1)}+C) \\ y & =\operatorname{ln}⁡(-{e}^{-(x - 1)}+C).\end{aligned}
$$

We now apply the condition $y(1)=-\operatorname{ln}⁡4$ to find $C:$

$$
\begin{aligned}y(1) & =-\operatorname{ln}⁡4 \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡(-{e}^{0}+C) & =-\operatorname{ln}⁡4 \\ \operatorname{ln}⁡(C-1) & =-\operatorname{ln}⁡4 \\ C-1 & =\frac{1}{4} \\ C & =\frac{5}{4}\end{aligned}
$$

Thus the particular solution of $\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}={e}^{-(x - 1)-y}$ that satisfies the condition $y(1)=-\operatorname{ln}⁡4$ is

$$
y=\operatorname{ln}⁡(\frac{5}{4}-{e}^{-(x - 1)}).
$$"] [:db/add "8cebb048-16ac-5152-999b-c80ad00cf72f" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "8cebb048-16ac-5152-999b-c80ad00cf72f" :question/answer-fields "0cdf3e68-d4de-5ad4-9574-fd9a9450108d"] [:db/ensure "8cebb048-16ac-5152-999b-c80ad00cf72f" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186100894 :knowledge-point/questions "8cebb048-16ac-5152-999b-c80ad00cf72f"] [:db/add "3c8df881-79fc-597e-905f-47b603e8fcc1" :answer/id #uuid "3c8df881-79fc-597e-905f-47b603e8fcc1"] [:db/add "3c8df881-79fc-597e-905f-47b603e8fcc1" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "3c8df881-79fc-597e-905f-47b603e8fcc1" :answer/value "-\frac{5}{(x + 3)}+4{(x + 3)}^{2}+7"] [:db/ensure "3c8df881-79fc-597e-905f-47b603e8fcc1" :answer/validate] [:db/add "9933f373-e852-5e58-920e-b22d113465ab" :answer-field/id #uuid "9933f373-e852-5e58-920e-b22d113465ab"] [:db/add "9933f373-e852-5e58-920e-b22d113465ab" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "9933f373-e852-5e58-920e-b22d113465ab" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "9933f373-e852-5e58-920e-b22d113465ab" :answer-field/choices "3c8df881-79fc-597e-905f-47b603e8fcc1"] [:db/add "9933f373-e852-5e58-920e-b22d113465ab" :answer-field/correct "3c8df881-79fc-597e-905f-47b603e8fcc1"] [:db/ensure "9933f373-e852-5e58-920e-b22d113465ab" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "6f76f884-1ea4-506a-b48f-3d11fe42414b" :question/id #uuid "6f76f884-1ea4-506a-b48f-3d11fe42414b"] [:db/add "6f76f884-1ea4-506a-b48f-3d11fe42414b" :question/problem "Find the particular solution to the differential equation ${(x + 3)}^{2}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}-8{(x + 3)}^{3}=5$ that satisfies $y(-2)=6.$

{{field-1}}"] [:db/add "6f76f884-1ea4-506a-b48f-3d11fe42414b" :question/worked-solution "We first find the general solution and then apply the given initial condition to find a particular solution.

Separating variables and integrating both sides with respect to $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{(x + 3)}^{2}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}-8{(x + 3)}^{3} & =5 \\ {(x + 3)}^{2}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =5+8{(x + 3)}^{3} \\ \text{d}y & =(5{(x + 3)}^{-2}+8(x + 3))\,\text{d}x \\ \int \text{d}y & =\int (5{(x + 3)}^{-2}+8(x + 3))\,\text{d}x \\ y & =-5{(x + 3)}^{-1}+4{(x + 3)}^{2}+C.\end{aligned}
$$

We now apply the initial condition $y(-2)=6$ to find $C:$

$$

Thus, the particular solution is

$$"] [:db/add "6f76f884-1ea4-506a-b48f-3d11fe42414b" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "6f76f884-1ea4-506a-b48f-3d11fe42414b" :question/answer-fields "9933f373-e852-5e58-920e-b22d113465ab"] [:db/ensure "6f76f884-1ea4-506a-b48f-3d11fe42414b" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186100894 :knowledge-point/questions "6f76f884-1ea4-506a-b48f-3d11fe42414b"] [:db/add "4e01c205-50bc-5b38-bb49-500a06736b9d" :answer/id #uuid "4e01c205-50bc-5b38-bb49-500a06736b9d"] [:db/add "4e01c205-50bc-5b38-bb49-500a06736b9d" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "4e01c205-50bc-5b38-bb49-500a06736b9d" :answer/value "6\sqrt{(x + 2)}+2{(x + 2)}^{2}+3"] [:db/ensure "4e01c205-50bc-5b38-bb49-500a06736b9d" :answer/validate] [:db/add "9260f8a1-641f-53e5-bfac-d94a2cad0c72" :answer-field/id #uuid "9260f8a1-641f-53e5-bfac-d94a2cad0c72"] [:db/add "9260f8a1-641f-53e5-bfac-d94a2cad0c72" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "9260f8a1-641f-53e5-bfac-d94a2cad0c72" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "9260f8a1-641f-53e5-bfac-d94a2cad0c72" :answer-field/choices "4e01c205-50bc-5b38-bb49-500a06736b9d"] [:db/add "9260f8a1-641f-53e5-bfac-d94a2cad0c72" :answer-field/correct "4e01c205-50bc-5b38-bb49-500a06736b9d"] [:db/ensure "9260f8a1-641f-53e5-bfac-d94a2cad0c72" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "1d2a9b12-3282-565d-8e04-5064a23ae3d7" :question/id #uuid "1d2a9b12-3282-565d-8e04-5064a23ae3d7"] [:db/add "1d2a9b12-3282-565d-8e04-5064a23ae3d7" :question/problem "Find the particular solution to the differential equation $\sqrt{(x + 2)}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}-4(x + 2)\sqrt{(x + 2)}=3$ that satisfies $y(-1)=11.$

{{field-1}}"] [:db/add "1d2a9b12-3282-565d-8e04-5064a23ae3d7" :question/worked-solution "We first find the general solution and then apply the given initial condition to find a particular solution.

Separating variables and integrating both sides with respect to $x,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\sqrt{(x + 2)}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}-4(x + 2)\sqrt{(x + 2)} & =3 \\ \sqrt{(x + 2)}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =3+4(x + 2)\sqrt{(x + 2)} \\ \text{d}y & =(3{(x + 2)}^{-1/2}+4(x + 2))\,\text{d}x \\ \int \text{d}y & =\int (3{(x + 2)}^{-1/2}+4(x + 2))\,\text{d}x \\ y & =6{(x + 2)}^{1/2}+2{(x + 2)}^{2}+C.\end{aligned}
$$

We now apply the initial condition $y(-1)=11$ to find $C:$

$$
\begin{aligned}y(-1) & =11 \\ 6(1)^{1/2}+2(1)^{2}+C & =11 \\ C+8 & =11 \\ C & =3\end{aligned}
$$

Thus, the particular solution is

$$
\begin{aligned}y(x) & =6{(x + 2)}^{1/2}+2{(x + 2)}^{2}+3 \\  & =6\sqrt{(x + 2)}+2{(x + 2)}^{2}+3.\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "1d2a9b12-3282-565d-8e04-5064a23ae3d7" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "1d2a9b12-3282-565d-8e04-5064a23ae3d7" :question/answer-fields "9260f8a1-641f-53e5-bfac-d94a2cad0c72"] [:db/ensure "1d2a9b12-3282-565d-8e04-5064a23ae3d7" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186100894 :knowledge-point/questions "1d2a9b12-3282-565d-8e04-5064a23ae3d7"] [:db/add "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "7db3311b-d0ab-5eac-a1b4-0268180eab8b"] [:db/add "generator" :question-generator/script "generators/07/07a0e1b9378bd41b588b3e4179f20f12a90385f245583f971aedc16a0d37a0a8/17592186100894.py"] [:db/add 17592186100894 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] [:db/ensure 17592186100894 :knowledge-point/validate]]
